name: slap-a-kol
description: Slap-a-KOL — hyper-casual degen slap-fighting browser game prototype (static, no build step).

scripts.zip: mkdir -p dist && python3 -c "import zipfile,os;z=zipfile.ZipFile('dist/slap-a-kol.zip','w',zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED);[z.write(os.path.join(r,f),'slap-a-kol/'+os.path.join(r,f)) for d in ['css','js','vendor','assets'] for r,_,fs in os.walk(d) for f in fs];[z.write(f,'slap-a-kol/'+f) for f in ['index.html','README.md']];z.close()"
